fail_closed_states.MEDIA_SOURCE_UNKNOWN: provider/source id or stable source URL missing
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_COMMERCIAL_USE_BLOCKED: commercial use is prohibited or not established
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_MODIFICATION_BLOCKED: required crop/retouch is outside verified permission
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_ATTRIBUTION_UNSATISFIED: required attribution cannot be preserved in target placement
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_PERSON_RIGHTS_REVIEW_REQUIRED: identifiable person creates unresolved release/endorsement/privacy risk
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_TRADEMARK_REVIEW_REQUIRED: logo/brand/trademark is visible and commercial use is unsafe or unclear
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY_MISMATCH: illustrative asset is being used/captioned as factual company evidence
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_BINARY_CHANGED: downloaded binary hash does not match approved record
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_RIGHTS_STALE: recheck trigger fired or required terms snapshot is stale/unavailable
fail_closed_states.MEDIA_ROLE_UNSATISFIED: no rights-safe asset remains for required role
fail_closed_states.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: rights are conditionally usable but cannot be resolved deterministically

hard_rules: official-site visibility is never treated as reuse permission
unknown or insufficient rights fail closed
generic stock/generated imagery is illustrative by default
generic imagery must never be represented as actual company staff, customer, store, studio, salon, treatment result, training result, testimonial, qualification, or performance evidence
provider-level commercial license does not erase third-party person/property/trademark rights
asset scarcity never changes Creative Family or authored topology
rights failure may downgrade/remove a media realization only within the already-frozen Family/scene intent or require human review

allowed_labels: actual result only when separately verified

person_sensitivity_rules: an identifiable person in generic stock may illustrate a generic consultation/process only when terms and third-party rights allow and copy/alt/placement do not imply that person works for or endorses the target company
customer-like people must not be paired with testimonial/result language unless they are verified company-specific evidence
health/beauty/fitness contexts require extra caution against implying medical, body-transformation, treatment-efficacy, or personal endorsement claims
recheck_triggers: asset source page removed or materially changed
new target use introduces a previously unreviewed person/property/trademark condition
